primary.method: Serial alternating baseline/candidate browser contexts. The cold field is the first invocation in a fresh document after selector seeding in a discarded document and requested GC, NOT a cold isolate/process: the Page/context is reused and JIT/code caches can remain warm. Warm samples follow three warmups. DOM setup, selector seeding, IPC and profiling are outside timed intervals. Each version captures its own selectors from identical original content; the unchanged-upgrade case removes additive basis evidence. Seeding resets the fixture's scan budget between independent comments (as independent saves do), reusing immutable text to avoid timing fixture generation. Timing is resolver/capture/index work, not whole-page startup. Profiled work/allocation and heap deltas are diagnostic, not latency samples.
primary.startupMethod: Genuine baseline and rebuilt candidate Shareable templates, fresh browser contexts, serial alternating order, at most five samples per version and no warmups. Readiness is navigation-to-runtime-ready (performance.now), including parsing and runtime startup. Selector/context seeding is outside timing and uses each actual runtime. Native saved comments have captured context; legacy-context-medium deliberately omits it. Every loaded root and attached highlight is counted. HTTP(S) requests are denied.
